items.title: Joseph "Red" Clark Interview, 1959-11-11
items.q: The method that I was taught out of? The Perkins. Well, Arthur Langlands. I have one laying around here somewhere now that I bought with a bass. I don't know where it is. I'm familiar with that.

ctx.x: Do you remember the name of the method, who wrote the method that you used, the books?

The method that I was taught out of? The Perkins. Well, Arthur Langlands. I have one laying around here somewhere now that I bought with a bass. I don't know where it is. I'm familiar with that. But it's somewhere around here. My wife had all those things when she was living, she kept all those things in a certain spot. And it's around here in some of these boxes.
I wanted to ask a little bit more about Perkins. What was his main instrument when he took a job and played in bands? What?
